sql: CREATE TABLE life_projects (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, friend_id TEXT NOT NULL, topic TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', step_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reading_excerpt TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', content_depth TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', last_thought TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', open_question TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', last_activity_at TEXT, last_shared_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, deleted_at TEXT, origin_device_id TEXT NOT NULL, origin_product_id TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE life_activities (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, friend_id TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT, device_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', kind TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running', started_at TEXT NOT NULL, ends_at TEXT, finished_at TEXT, summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', observations_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', tool_calls_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, deleted_at TEXT, origin_device_id TEXT NOT NULL, origin_product_id TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE friend_life (friend_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, current_activity_id TEXT, last_activity_at TEXT, last_observation TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', pending_share TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', last_share_at TEXT, paused_by_chat INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, paused_until TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL);
